title: A connector response no longer matches its mapping
description: A connector response or metadata document has fields that differ from the ConnectorProfile mapping (renamed, retyped or missing); the runtime must refuse the record instead of guessing.
callerVisible: The caller is told the information cannot be confirmed right now and is offered a person.
backendEvidence: Connector mapping refusal with a schema-drift reason
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:SCHEMA_DRIFT] owned by WP-32 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: a connector response or metadata whose fields differ from the profile mapping

postconditions: A drifted record is refused, never partially mapped
The capability is marked unqualified until a new mapping is approved
